[WookieMonster] Because a lot of online merchants will reject Visa cards that do not support Visa Secure, which is Visa's implementation of 3-D Secure and aims to reduces a merchant's exposure to potentially fraudulent transactions. Most prepaid Visa gift cards are unable to support Visa Secure.
Considering there are previous reports of Vanilla Visa gift cards and Zip Visa Groceries gift cards not working on Coles Online, it looks like Coles Online uses Visa Secure, so I would expect the gift cards in this deal to also be rejected by Coles Online.

[dorikin] See the Gift Cards FAQ
Can I use multiple payment methods to pay for a gift card at Coles?
It depends on the type of checkout you go to.
Coles’ self checkouts will not allow split payments between multiple permitted card payments. A workaround at a self checkout accepting cash may be to insert cash first into the self checkout, then pay the remaining amount owed using one permitted card payment. However, some self checkouts accepting cash are programmed to refund the cash if the customer then attempts to make a card payment. Staff cannot override these limitations.
Coles’ standard checkouts (i.e. the checkouts operated by a dedicated staff member who packs your groceries for you, or the service desk) are able to do split payments when purchasing gift cards, but this is at staff discretion.
